name: MoM %
description: Growth against the previous month.
body:
VAR _prior = CALCULATE({{measure}}, DATEADD({{dates}}, -1, MONTH))
RETURN DIVIDE({{measure}} - _prior, _prior)

name: YTD vs prior YTD %
description: Year-to-date growth against the previous year-to-date.
body:
VAR _ytd = TOTALYTD({{measure}}, {{dates}})
VAR _pytd = CALCULATE(TOTALYTD({{measure}}, {{dates}}), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR({{dates}}))
RETURN DIVIDE(_ytd - _pytd, _pytd)

name: Cumulative % (Pareto)
description: Cumulative share of items ranked from largest to smallest.
body:
VAR _v = {{measure}}
VAR _items = ALLSELECTED({{column}})
VAR _cum = SUMX(FILTER(_items, {{measure}} >= _v), {{measure}})
RETURN DIVIDE(_cum, SUMX(_items, {{measure}}))
